component.name: LinksScene
component.script:
sub init() m.timer = CreateObject("roSGNode", "Timer") m.timer.duration = 0.5 m.timer.observeField("fire", "runCases") m.timer.control = "start" end sub
function makeCase(name as string, forward as boolean) as object c = CreateObject("roSGNode", "FwdContainer") c.id = name + "C" c.forward = forward for each id in ["a", "b"] n = CreateObject("roSGNode", "Group") n.id = name + id n.focusable = true c.appendChild(n) end for other = CreateObject("roSGNode", "Group") other.id = name + "other" other.focusable = true m.top.appendChildren([c, other]) return { c: c, a: c.getChild(0), b: c.getChild(1), other: other } end function
function link(n as object) as string fc = n.focusedChild s = "-" if fc <> invalid if fc.isSameNode(n) then s = "self" else s = fc.id end if hf = "F" if n.hasFocus() then hf = "T" return n.id + "=" + hf + "/" + s end function
sub dump(label as string, k as object) sfc = "-" if m.top.focusedChild <> invalid then sfc = m.top.focusedChild.id print "PROBE|" + label + "|" + link(k.c) + " " + link(k.a) + " " + link(k.b) + " " + link(k.other) + " sceneFC=" + sfc end sub
sub runCases() k = makeCase("s1", true) k.c.setFocus(true) dump("S1 C.setFocus fwd a", k) k.b.setFocus(true) dump("S1 b.setFocus", k)
k = makeCase("s2", true) k.c.setFocus(true) dump("S2 C.setFocus fwd a", k) k.other.setFocus(true) dump("S2 other.setFocus", k)
k = makeCase("s3", false) k.c.setFocus(true) k.a.setFocus(true) dump("S3 a.setFocus", k) k.b.setFocus(true) dump("S3 b.setFocus", k)
k = makeCase("s4", true) k.c.setFocus(true) dump("S4 C.setFocus fwd a", k) k.c.setFocus(true) dump("S4 C.setFocus again", k) k.b.setFocus(true) dump("S4 b.setFocus", k) print "PROBE|done" end sub
